title: Find which push keeps raising the stray-branch ask, and make it name its destination
why: Owner ask ask-mw8321blnx (11:05 CST Nov 8): the push-stray-branch ask reached him on "Push the merged lane head", and he asks why it keeps coming up in the past 36 h. Decision plain-push-asks (rulings 206 a and 207 a, 2026-11-03) asks on an implied push (`git push origin HEAD`, a bare push) whose name differs from the branch's upstream; an explicit `HEAD:<branch>` is silent. The rate and the sessions are unmeasured: guard.log on the Mac holds them.
